text:
Sam: quick sync — launching a 2-week micro-saves sprint for accounts with health <45. Goal: 15 saves, 10 re-engaged. Short list of tactics below, need volunteers and owners.

Maria: I'm in. I have 6 flagged accounts. I can own onboarding fixes + outreach cadence.

Ajay: happy to help with prompt/template audits and a quick cost-optim checklist for each account. Will share a snippet.

Lisa: I can package recent support logs and common error patterns. Suggest we tag inbound tickets `#micro-save` so we can filter.

Priya: we need clear downgrade/concession guardrails before reps promise anything. What's allowed? credits? free training? timeline?

Sam: concessions quick rules: one-time credits up to $500 without exec review, one free 60-min workshop, temporary feature flags for 30 days. No permanent price cuts w/o Rev approval. Response SLA for micro-saves is 48h for owner action.

Sam: sprint checklist (compact):
```
1) Owner outreach within 24h (email + 15-min discovery)
2) Quick triage: onboarding gaps, usage limits, prompt quality, infra errors
3) Apply 1 micro-win (template, template library, small quota bump, workshop)
4) Offer 30-day review + metrics to measure
5) If customer still wants to leave: surface downgrade options + churn questionnaire
```

Maria: putting a templated email draft in the shared folder now. Suggest cadence: Day0 outreach, Day3 check, Day10 workshop, Day20 check-in.

Ajay: sharing prompt audit snippet: `- top failing prompts -> reduce temperature, add system instruction, pin context snippets` I'll DM links to templates.

Lisa: created `#micro-save` tag in support and added two saved searches: "low-health + open tickets" and "last-active >30d + billing alerts".

Priya: I'll draft a short concessions flow: who approves credits >$500, how to escalate, and the downgrade matrix (feature-limited vs usage-limited). Posting doc link in a bit.

Sam: owners: @Maria -> 6 accounts, @Ajay -> assist with 4 audits, @Lisa -> support bundle for all, @Priya -> concessions + downgrade matrix. I'll ping RevOps for fast approvals.

churn-bot: Automated: 6 accounts tagged `micro-save`; scheduled reminder in 3 days for owners.

Ajay: one quick ask — can we standardize the metric we report back? Recommend: MAU change, avg token spend, key error rate. Short dashboard tile would be ideal.

Sam: agree. Ops: add a dashboard tile: "Micro-saves KPIs" with MAU delta, tokens delta, and success action applied. Priya, can you list the metric thresholds we care about?

Priya: will post thresholds: >10% MAU uplick, >-20% token delta, and error rate reduction >50% as success signals.

Maria: outreach draft in `docs/shared/micro-saves/email-draft-v1.md`. Using a short survey at the end to capture reasons for churn (product fit, cost, onboarding, other).

Sam: perfect. We'll run first batch outreach tomorrow morning. Daily stand 10am for sprint owners. Keep messages short in thread, add any red flags. :thumbsup:

Lisa: noted. I'll surface any systemic bugs immediately.

Ajay: sharing templates in channel after stand.

Sam: thanks team — let’s prioritize quick wins. If anyone hits a roadblock, ping me and I'll escalate.
